title: Practitioner Wound Evaluations and Healed-Wound Records in the Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Wound evaluations and healed wounds — Wound Care Supply Program

Clinical documentation policy on the wound evaluation each refill rests on and on wounds that have healed.

## Evaluation before each refill

On tiers where the wound evaluation interval is greater than 0, a refill ships only when the program's most recent medical record with the purpose wound evaluation, recording the wound's measurements and drainage, is dated no more than the wound evaluation interval, in calendar days, before the ship date, counted in calendar days back from the ship date with the last day allowed; the customer's own description of the wound never replaces the evaluation.

The drainage level on the newest evaluation is written onto the program by a program change.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, ship date 2026-08-20, interval of 30 days).*

| Date of the most recent wound evaluation | Refill may ship on 2026-08-20 |
|---|---|
| 2026-07-21 | Yes — the last day is allowed |
| 2026-07-20 | No — more than 30 days before the ship date |

## Healed wounds

When a medical record with the purpose wound healed report shows the wound has healed, no further dressings ship for it; the customer confirms closing the program, which closes with the closure reason wound healed, and any unopened dressings delivered within the return window stay returnable under the return terms.

## Points of judgement

- The evaluation that counts is the most recent wound evaluation record of the program, and it rests on the practitioner's record, not on the customer's description of the wound.
- Once a wound healed report is on file for a wound, no further dressings ship for that wound.
